title: no Wear Collection Service with miaomiao2
body: Using last nightly xdrip 2019.10.11, smartwatch sony swr50 Android 5.1. If I connect smartwach with smartphone I can reveive data on watch. If I use watch as standalone with miaomiao2 no data were read. Smartwach sees mm2 as Limitter.

comments.body:
I also have a problem with this.
I have last nightly xdrip 2019.10.27. I am using Huawei Watch 2 LTE (original stock roms OWDE.180215.017) with patch fix-boot-security.zip and huawei-watch-2-4g-demi-update-patch by jamorham.
If I connect smartwach with smartphone I can reveive data on watch.
When there is no smartphone nearby, the smartwatch does not work as a date collector.
I read here -> https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/374,
"It seems your vesion from 13/04/2019 works fine! And the new versions don't have access to Wear API."

Only that version 13.04.2019 does not work for me with MiaoMiao 2 Reader.
It's true. It's also happening to me with a Google Pixel 1, and with a Moto G5+.

Here's a xDrip+ version totally functional with MM2 in smartwatches: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1g55RRmRgmAzsQpHRngDCW5pQoprYKj_i/view?usp=drivesdk

Remember to pair the watch to the MM2.

@t12lo Would you please close this issue if it has been resolved?
If not, would you please ask using the support channels to see what others are doing?
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
Thanks
